title: observability-weekly-2026-10-19
content:
Observability team weekly notes — 2026-10-19
Owners: Asha (lead), collaborators: Liam, Sofia, Diego
Context: ongoing efforts to stabilize tracing ingestion pipeline, reduce dashboard noise, and finalize cost telemetry rollout for Dedicated customers. Notes capture standups, meeting summaries, action items, and open questions.

1) Weekly highlights
- Tracing: Ingest pipeline backfill complete for 2026-10-12 -> 2026-10-18 window. Root cause for the sampler config drift identified as a config-sync bug in the control plane (PR link in linked_artifacts).
- Dashboards: New per-route latency heatmap launched to console beta. Early feedback: useful but heavy on ElasticSearch cost; exploring aggregation tiering.
- Cost telemetry: Initial cost attribution prototype for Dedicated customers is instrumented and producing per-request cost estimates (within +/- 8% compared to offline model).

2) Standup logs (concise)
- 2026-10-19 09:15 — Asha: tracing backfill verified, still seeing ~2% of traces missing KV cache metadata; investigating exporter ordering.
- 2026-10-19 09:17 — Liam: dashboard query optimizations reduced CPU usage on ES by ~18%; still need better TTL for low-cardinality indexes.
- 2026-10-19 09:20 — Sofia: cost telemetry ingestion hooked into billing pipeline; noticed duplicate records when retry happens — dedupe needed.
- 2026-10-19 09:22 — Diego: working on synthetic workload to validate tracing latency under 10k rps; infra tickets created.

3) Meetings this week
- Tracing sync (Mon): Reviewed sampler config drift; agreed to add gitops gating and automated config diff alerting. Owner: Asha. Action: small feature flag to revert sampler changes automatically (JIRA-OBS-7421).
- Dashboard review (Wed): Product requested per-tenant toggle to hide expensive panels. Outcome: add toggle + lazy aggregation job for heavy panels. Owner: Liam.
- Cost telemetry design review (Thu): Internal review with product & finance. Decision: release as opt-in for Dedicated customers, expose estimate and confidence band in console. Owner: Sofia.

4) Action items (owner — due)
- Add config-sync unit tests + immediate alert for sampler drift — Asha — due 2026-10-26
- Implement dedupe logic in cost ingestion path (idempotency token) — Sofia — due 2026-10-23
- Add per-tenant panel toggle and lazy agg job for heatmap panels — Liam — due 2026-11-02
- Run synthetic 10k rps tracing test and report perf regressions — Diego — due 2026-10-22
- Update runbook for tracing partial drops (include KV cache missing metadata case) — Asha & SRE — due 2026-10-21

5) Metrics & telemetry snapshot (notes, not the raw CSV)
- Traces ingested (last 7d): ~7.4M (backfill included). Missing-KV-cache traces: ~2% of total during drift window.
- Console dashboard queries (avg qps): 320 -> after opt: 260 (18% drop).
- Cost telemetry ingestion lag: median 45s, p95 4.8m, duplicate rate observed ~0.9% under retries.

6) Incidents / postmortems
- Incident: 2026-10-15 sampling config drift causing under-sampling for ~6h. Impact: small fraction of traces underrepresented for high-latency tails; surfaced by QA and internal alerts. Mitigation: reverted config via manual change, backfilled traces. Follow-up: add automated gating and alert described above.

7) Risks / open questions
- ES cost for heavy dashboards — should we move expensive aggregations to ClickHouse/OLAP store? Prospect: reduce ES cost but adds complexity. Request: Product + Finance to evaluate cost tradeoffs; tagging required.
- Cost model accuracy in high-quantization scenarios (quantized model variants): our perimeter model may undercount GPU inf cost. Need to validate with Dedicated telemetry.
- Sampling vs full-trace tradeoffs for debug mode — proposal to enable full-trace capture for a small % of requests when SLO violations occur. Open: storage/retention impact.

8) Notes to self / brainstorm fragments
- Could leverage per-route caching of heavy aggregations with TTL based on traffic volatility.
- Consider a "cost confidence" score on console to communicate estimate quality (green/yellow/red).
- Investigate using tracing tags to mark model-variant metadata earlier in the call chain to improve attribution.

9) Linked work & refs
- See linked artifacts for tracing config PR and cost ingestion PR.
- Related Confluence: CONFL-OBS-2026-10-tracing-standards (design doc).
- Related Jira: JIRA-OBS-7421 (sampler drift fix), JIRA-OBS-7434 (cost-dedupe).

10) Next week priorities
- Primary: deploy sampler drift automated alert + gating; run canary for config change pipeline.
- Secondary: dedupe in cost ingestion + initial Dedicated opt-in for cost telemetry.
- Tertiary: dashboard aggregation prototype in ClickHouse eval environment; prepare cost/benefit for product review.

If any questions or missed items, add below or ping in #eng-observability.
